Based on the screenshot provided:

(1) **Yes**, there is a status message visible at the bottom right of the main view. Its exact text is: **"No chats need attention."** (with a "Dismiss" button next to it).

(2) **No**, the main chat view is not showing a specific chat. Instead, it displays a welcome screen with the text **"What should we work on?"** and sign-in options. In the sidebar, the **"seed-ws"** project row is highlighted/selected (it has a light blue background), but no individual chat row is selected because the "Chats" section explicitly states **"No chats"**.

(3) **No**, there are no unread dots on any chat rows, as there are no chat rows present in the list.
